threads.body: The InputStream argument is never closed. Since `openClasspathResource(...)` returns a live stream, each test invocation can leak a resource/handle. Prefer passing the resource name (String) via the MethodSource and opening it inside the test (or closing `input` with try-with-resources inside the manifest supplier) so the stream is always closed.

`PROVIDER_CLASS_NAME` is hard-coded as a binary class name string (including `$Provider`). This is brittle on refactors/relocations and can silently get out of sync with the nested `Provider` class. Prefer deriving it from the class (e.g., `Provider.class.getName()`) where it’s used in the argument rows.
